<p align="right" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:right;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Exhibit 99.1</font></b></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The shares of the Issuer&#146;s common stock reported as beneficially owned are held of record by (i)&nbsp;Apollo Centre Street Partnership, L.P. (&#147;Centre Street LP&#148;) (399,651 shares), (ii)&nbsp;Apollo Credit Opportunity Trading Fund III (&#147;Opportunity III&#148;) (2,297,345 shares), (iii)&nbsp;Apollo Special Opportunities Managed Account, L.P. (&#147;SOMA Fund&#148;) (1,262,956 shares), and (iv)&nbsp;Apollo Zeus Strategic Investments, L.P. (&#147;Zeus&nbsp;LP&#148;) (420,976 shares). Apollo Franklin Partnership, L.P. (&#147;Apollo Franklin&#148;), AEC (Lux) S.&#224; r.l. (&#147;AEC (Lux)&#148;), AES (Lux) S.&#224; r.l. (&#147;AES (Lux)&#148;) and ANS U.S. Holdings Ltd. (&#147;ANS US,&#148; together with Centre Street LP, Opportunity III, SOMA Fund, Zeus LP, Apollo Franklin, AEC (Lux) and AES (Lux), the &#147;Funds&#148;) are no longer holders of record of any shares of the Issuer&#146;s common stock.</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Apollo Centre Street Management, LLC (&#147;Centre Street Management&#148;) serves as the investment manager for Centre Street LP.&nbsp; Apollo Franklin Management, LLC (&#147;Franklin Management&#148;) serves as the investment manager for Apollo Franklin.&nbsp;Apollo Credit Opportunity Fund III LP (&#147;Opportunity III LP&#148;) and Apollo Credit Opportunity Fund (Offshore) III LP (&#147;Offshore Opportunity III LP&#148;) serve as the general partners of Opportunity III. Apollo Credit Opportunity Management III LLC (&#147;Opportunity Management III&#148;) serves as the investment manager for each of Opportunity III LP and Offshore Opportunity III LP. Apollo European Credit Management, L.P. (&#147;AEC Management LP&#148;) serves as the investment manager for AEC (Lux).&nbsp; Apollo European Credit Management GP, LLC (&#147;AEC Management LLC&#148;) serves as the general partner of AEC Management LP.&nbsp; Apollo European Strategic Management, L.P. (&#147;AES Management LP&#148;) serves as the investment manager for AES (Lux).&nbsp; Apollo European Strategic Management GP LLC (&#147;AES Management LLC&#148;) serves as the general partner for AES Management LP. Apollo SK Strategic Investments, L.P. (&#147;SK Strategic LP&#148;) is the sole member-manager of ANS US. Apollo SK Strategic Management, LLC (&#147;SK Strategic Management&#148;) serves as the investment manager for SK Strategic LP.</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Apollo SOMA Advisors, L.P. (&#147;SOMA Advisors&#148;) serves as the general partner of SOMA Fund, and Apollo SOMA Capital Management, LLC (&#147;SOMA Capital Management&#148;) serves as the general partner of SOMA Advisors.&nbsp; APH Holdings (DC), L.P. (&#147;APH&#148;) serves as the sole member and manager of SOMA Capital Management, and Apollo Principal Holdings IV GP,&nbsp;Ltd. (&#147;Principal&nbsp;IV&nbsp;GP&#148;) serves as the general partner of APH.&nbsp; Apollo SVF Management, L.P. (&#147;SVF Management&#148;) serves as the investment manager of SOMA Fund, and Apollo SVF Management GP, LLC (&#147;SVF Management GP&#148;) serves as the general partner of SVF Management.&nbsp; Apollo Zeus Strategic Management, LLC (&#147;Zeus Management&#148;) serves as the investment manager for Zeus&nbsp;LP.</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Apollo Capital Management, L.P. (&#147;Capital Management&#148;) is the sole member and manager of Centre Street Management, Franklin Management, Opportunity Management&nbsp;III, AEC Management LLC, AES Management LLC, SK&nbsp;Strategic Management, SVF Management GP and Zeus Management.&nbsp; Apollo Capital Management GP, LLC (&#147;Capital Management GP&#148;) is the general partner of Capital Management.&nbsp; Apollo Management Holdings, L.P. (&#147;Management Holdings&#148;) serves as the sole member and manager of Capital Management GP.&nbsp; Apollo Management Holdings GP, LLC (&#147;Management Holdings GP&#148;) is the general partner of Management Holdings.&nbsp; Leon Black, Joshua Harris and Marc Rowan are the managers of Principal IV GP, and the managers, as well as executive officers, of Management Holdings GP.</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Each of the Funds disclaims beneficial ownership of any shares of the Issuer&#146;s common stock owned of record by the other Funds, and each of Centre Street Management, Franklin Management, Opportunity III LP, Offshore Opportunity III LP, Opportunity Management III, AEC Management LP, AEC Management LLC, AES Management LP, AES Management LLC, SK Strategic LP, SK Strategic Management, SOMA Advisors, SOMA Capital Management, APH, Principal IV GP, SVF Management, SVF Management GP, Zeus Management, Capital Management, Capital Management GP, Management Holdings and Management Holdings GP, and Messrs.&nbsp;Black, Harris and Rowan, disclaims beneficial ownership of any shares of the Issuer&#146;s common stock owned of record by the Funds, in each case except to the extent of any pecuniary interest therein, and this report shall not be deemed an admission that any such entity is the beneficial owner of or has any pecuniary interest in, such securities for purposes of Section&nbsp;16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or for any other purpose.</font></p>
